Before you create a pipeline with a Lambda processor, create the following resources:
• An AWS Lambda function that enriches and transforms your source data. For instructions, see
Create your ﬁrst Lambda function.
• An OpenSearch Service domain or OpenSearch Serverless collection that will be the pipeline
sink. For more information, see the section called “ Creating OpenSearch Service domains” and
the section called “Creating collections”.
• A pipeline role that includes permissions to write to the domain or collection sink. For more
information, see the section called “Pipeline role”.
The pipeline role also needs an attached permissions policy that allows it to invoke the Lambda
function speciﬁed in the pipeline conﬁguration. For example:
